items.title: Eric Alexander interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010

ctx.x: Yeah. And he must have, I have to think that he heard something that made him feel like okay this student is worth my while.

Well I can only speculate. I’ll tell you I was very scared, but so ignorant was I, I didn’t know who Harold Mabern was. I mean I could tell that he was somebody super important, but I didn’t know who he was. And I had spent that summer switching from alto saxophone to tenor, and I had just gotten an old Otto Link mouthpiece, which is what I’ve been playing since then, and had to figure out how to play it, and I’d been listening to some Coltrane records kind of trying to approximate that sound. So maybe when I…
And a lot of people, George Coleman is not on a lot of people’s lists.
